stem: A child is delayed in language, gross motor, fine motor and social developmental domains. Which term best describes this pattern?
explanation: Global developmental delay describes significant delay across more than one developmental domain. Isolated speech delay affects language alone, while autism is primarily defined by social-communication differences and restricted or repetitive behaviours.
